parameters: Bonanza! So many little toy soldiers on the battlefield, just for me.\! Very well, if my actions today will grease the wheels of power, so be it.
\c[1]Just enough to stop their momentum, Beatrix!\! Don't kill everyone right now - we need more time to prepare for the next phase!
Quiet, old man, I was born for this...\| It's time, my poor little soldiers... come to Beatrix!
Th-that mage is some sort of demon!!\! Men of Isanter, full retreat!!
...How dare you? Did I order you to retreat?\! I am not bored with slaughtering you yet!
Damn. We're on our own out here.\! If you want something done right...
That enemy sorceress singlehandedly decimated Isanter's most elite forces...\! Unless you've got something up your sleeve, \n[8], I pray you find a way to avoid sending our troops anywhere near her.
Noted. Let's see how this shakes out.
My gracious... these ones are feisty.\! Oh well, I've had my fill.\! Have fun playing war, darlings.
If we don't see her again, it'll be too soon.
Sigh... what a bore, these temple types.\! But I do think I've sent enough of them to the void for today.\! Have fun playing war, darlings! Nap time for Beatrix.
If we don't see her again, it'll be too soon.
